arxiv-2202-06611.title: Directional distributions and the half-angle principle
arxiv-2202-06611.creator: John T. Kent
arxiv-2202-06611.description: Abstract Angle halving, or alternatively the reverse operation of angle doubling, is a useful tool when studying directional distributions. It is especially useful on the circle where, in particular, it yields an identification between the wrapped Cauchy distribution and the angular central Gaussian distributions, as well as a matching of their parameterizations.

arxiv-2204-07948.title: Massive Trajectory Matching and Construction from Aerial Videos based on Frame-by-Frame Vehicle Detections
arxiv-2204-07948.creator: Ruyi Feng a , Zhibin Li a and Changyan Fan a
arxiv-2204-07948.description: Abstract Vehicle trajectory data provides critical information for traffic flow modeling and analysis. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) is an emerging technology for traffic data collection because of its flexibility and diversity on spatial and temporal coverage. Vehicle trajectories are constructed from frame-by-frame detections. The increase of vehicle counts makes multiple-target matching more challenging.

arxiv-2211-12889.title: The fractional Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation
arxiv-2211-12889.creator: R.C. Verstraten 1 , T. Ludwig 1 , R.A. Duine 1,2 , C. Morais Smith 1
arxiv-2211-12889.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by R.C. Verstraten 1 , T. Ludwig 1 , R.A. Duine 1,2 , C. Morais Smith 1. The dynamics of a magnetic moment or spin are of high interest to applications in technology. Dissipation in these systems is therefore of importance for improvement of efficiency of devices, such as the ones proposed in spintronics. A large spin in a magnetic field is widely assumed to be described by the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation, which includes a phenomenological Gilbert damping.

arxiv-2311-02108.title: A Virtual Reality Training System for Automotive Engines Assembly and Disassembly
arxiv-2311-02108.creator: Gongjin Lan ID, Qiangqiang Lai, Bing Bai, Zirui Zhao, Qi Hao ID
arxiv-2311-02108.description: Abstract Automotive engine assembly and disassembly are common and crucial programs in the automotive industry. Traditional education trains students to learn automotive engine assembly and disassembly in lecture courses and then to operate with physical engines, which are generally low effectiveness and high cost.

arxiv-2402-06455.title: Quantum Computing and Tensor Networks for Laminate Design: A Novel Approach to Stacking Sequence Retrieval
arxiv-2402-06455.creator: Arne Wulff, Boyang Chen, Matthew Steinberg, Yinglu Tang, Matthias Möller, Sebastian Feld
arxiv-2402-06455.description: Abstract As with many tasks in engineering, structural design frequently involves navigating complex and computationally expensive problems. A prime example is the weight optimization of laminated composite materials, which to this day remains a formidable task, due to an exponentially large configuration space and non-linear constraints.

arxiv-2407-20722.title: Persistent Sampling: Enhancing the Efficiency of Sequential Monte Carlo
arxiv-2407-20722.creator: Minas Karamanis, Uroš Seljak
arxiv-2407-20722.description: Abstract Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) samplers are powerful tools for Bayesian inference but suffer from high computational costs due to their reliance on large particle ensembles for accurate estimates. We introduce persistent sampling (PS), an extension of SMC that systematically retains and reuses particles from all prior iterations to construct a growing, weighted ensemble.

arxiv-2503-03225.title: Targeted Distillation for Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2503-03225.creator: Yice Zhang, Guangyu Xie, Jingjie Lin, Jianzhu Bao, Qianlong Wang, Xi Zeng, Ruifeng Xu
arxiv-2503-03225.description: Abstract This paper presents a compact model that achieves strong sentiment analysis capabilities through targeted distillation from advanced large language models (LLMs). Our methodology decouples the distillation target into two key components: sentiment-related knowledge and task alignment. To transfer these components, we propose a two-stage distillation framework.

arxiv-2509-23571.title: Benchmarking LLM-Assisted Blue Teaming via Standardized Threat Hunting
arxiv-2509-23571.creator: Yuqiao Meng 1 , Luoxi Tang 1 , Feiyang Yu 2 , Xi Li 3 , Guanhua Yan 1 , Ping Yang 1 , Zhaohan Xi 1
arxiv-2509-23571.description: Abstract As cyber threats continue to grow in scale and sophistication, blue team defenders increasingly require advanced tools to proactively detect and mitigate risks. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising capabilities for enhancing threat analysis. However, their effectiveness in real-world blue team threat-hunting scenarios remains insufficiently explored.

arxiv-2512-12140.title: Realizing Space-oriented Control in Smart Buildings via Word Embeddings Thanks:
arxiv-2512-12140.creator: Hangli Ge 1 , Hiroaki Mori 2 , Yasuhira Chiba 2 , Noboru Koshizuka 1 ,
arxiv-2512-12140.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel framework for implementing space-oriented control systems in smart buildings. In contrast to conventional device-oriented approaches, which often suffer from issues related to development efficiency and portability, our framework adopts a space-oriented paradigm that leverages natural language processing and word embedding techniques.

pmc-10595285.title: Exploring spatial patterns of cardiovascular disease among women in India
pmc-10595285.creator: T Patil, A Jana, S Gaurav
pmc-10595285.description: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) has become a leading cause of mortality and morbidity in India, surpassing the global rate. While CVD is influenced by gender due to sex-specific risk factors in women, it remains underdiagnosed, and undertreated in women. WHO provides a list of ‘best buys’ which does not consider sex-specific risk factors.

pmc-11396597.title: Prospective Analysis of the Effectiveness of Targeted Botulinum Toxin Type A Injection Using an Ultrasound-Guided Single-Point Injection Technique for Lower Face Contouring
pmc-11396597.creator: Hyun-Jung Ryoo, Ho Kwon, Jae-Seon Choi, Bo-Seong Sohn, Ja-Young Yoo, Hyung-Sup Shim
pmc-11396597.description: Background: Botulinum toxin type A (BoNT-A) injection is widely used for masseter hypertrophy. Traditional BoNT-A injection methods often incorporate landmark-guided blind injections, which approximate the shape of the masseter muscle inject across various points. Conversely, ultrasound (US)-guided injection techniques offer real-time visualization and dynamic monitoring, enhancing accuracy.

pmc-12460033.title: A Patient with Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia Treated with Prostatic Arterial Embolization: Case-report with Review of the Literature from Asia
pmc-12460033.creator: Shigeo Ichihashi, Daisuke Gotoh, Naoki Fujimura, Yuto Chanoki, Tatsuya Yokota, Katsuhiko Taira, Kazumasa Torimoto, Kiyohide Fujimoto, Tiago Bilhim, Toshihiro Tanaka
pmc-12460033.description: Prostatic artery embolization is a minimally invasive treatment for lower urinary tract symptoms caused by benign prostatic hyperplasia. We report our first case of prostatic artery embolization in a 74-year-old male with urinary retention requiring intermittent catheterization. Bilateral prostatic artery embolization using Embosphere microspheres was successful, with no major complications.

pmc-12567134.title: Rational Design, Computational Analysis and Antibacterial Activities of Synthesized Peptide-Based Molecules Targeting Quorum Sensing-Dependent Biofilm Formation in Pseudomonas aeruginosa
pmc-12567134.creator: Shokhan Jamal Hamid, Twana Mohsin Salih, Tavga Ahmed Aziz
pmc-12567134.description: Background/Objective: The rise in bacterial resistance necessitates novel therapeutic strategies beyond conventional antibiotics. Antimicrobial peptides represent promising candidates but face challenges such as instability, enzymatic degradation, and host toxicity. To overcome these limitations, conjugation and structural modifications are being explored.

pmc-12661869.title: Geophagy as a risk factor for Soil-transmitted helminthic infections among pregnant women attending antenatal care at health institutions in Chiro Town, Eastern Ethiopia
pmc-12661869.creator: Asfaw Mesfin, Mio Ayana, Mestawet Getachew, Zeleke Mekonnen
pmc-12661869.description: BackgroundGeophagia is recognized as a habit of compulsive eating of soil and is practiced globally, especially among African societies. It is especially common among pregnant women. This behavior may increase the risk of soil-transmitted helminth (STH) infections, which can adversely affect maternal health.

pmc-13069875.title: High Injury Incidence Among Youth in the World's Largest Handball Tournament: A Prospective Observational Study of 17 034 Participants
pmc-13069875.creator: Ida Lindman, Josefin Abrahamson
pmc-13069875.description: Partille Cup is the world's largest youth handball tournament. Research among youth handball players, and especially during tournaments, is scarce. The primary aim of this prospective study was to examine the incidence of injuries among youth handball players in Partille Cup. The secondary aim was to compare injury incidence by age, sex, and across days of the tournament.

uslaw-usc-t42-s3056k.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 35 (Programs For Older Americans); Subchapter IX (Community Service Senior Opportunities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Measures (1) Establishment and implementation of measures The Secretary shall establish and implement, after consultation with grantees, subgrantees, and host agencies under this subchapter, States, older individuals, area agencies on aging, and other organizations.

uslaw-usc-t43-s315q.title: 43 U.S.C. § 315q — Withdrawal of lands for war or national defense purposes; payment for cancellation of permits or licenses
uslaw-usc-t43-s315q.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s315q.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 8A (Grazing Lands); Subchapter I (Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whenever use for war or national defense purposes of the public domain or other property owned by or under the control of the United States prevents its use for grazing, persons holding grazing permits or licenses and persons whose grazing permits or licenses.
